The '''Domgrin system''' was a system where [[Talon Karrde]] informed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] that [[Dean Jinzler]] had stolen a message from [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], an [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], that was intended for Luke.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>
